scope: Selection-design rules for phone number candidates. This file does not define fixed pair fields.
source_level: D supplemental source plus v0.4 governance rules

structure_observation.description: Analyze an existing phone number structure only.

full_matching.description: Match existing phone structure with user context.

selection_design.description: Design candidate phone-number structures for a user goal. If bazi_yongshen is missing, resolve it through user input, an external bazi tool, or public web reference before selecting tail digits.

rules: Use user-provided bazi_yongshen directly and mark status as user_provided.
If bazi_yongshen is missing and search_allowed is true, use an external bazi tool or public web reference to resolve yongshen before tail digit design.
If bazi_yongshen is missing and online/tool access is unavailable, do not infer yongshen; request user-provided yongshen or provide only non-bazi structural guidance.
Bazi yongshen may guide tail digits only in selection design; it must not alter fixed phone pair maps or ordinary number observation.
Always return a source note and boundary note.

fire.note: Use 9 as the primary fire tail digit.

water.note: Use 1 as the primary water tail digit.

earth.note: Prefer 8; 2 is lower priority because it often constrains the final pair to small tianyi structures.

metal.note: Prefer 6; 7 can carry speech/conflict signals and should be used with care.

wood.note: Prefer 3; 4 can carry hesitation/repetition signals and should be buffered.

avoid_zero.rule: Selection candidates should avoid 0 when possible.

five_between_risk_fields.rule: Avoid A5B when the outer AB is a risk field such as 五鬼, 祸害, 绝命, or 六煞.

five_between_big_yannian.rule: Use caution with big yannian amplified by 5.

duplicate_big_tianyi.rule: Avoid stacking multiple big tianyi structures such as 13/31 plus 68/86 in the final design.

risk_field_count.rule: Risk fields should usually not exceed 3 and must be clearly carried by auspicious fields.

special_95_59.rule: 95/59 is a supplemental-source special yannian口径 only; do not add it to fixed pair maps.

preferred_prefix_notes.boundary: Prefix preferences require public availability or carrier verification and are not deterministic fate rules.

boundary_note: Selection candidates are auxiliary matching suggestions. They do not guarantee wealth, health, marriage, legal, investment, financial, inventory, or purchase outcomes.
